description: Defines the TransactionSearchRequest class used for constructing search criteria for transactions, including date ranges, amounts, types, and pagination details.

classes.name: TransactionSearchRequest
classes.description: A data class for encapsulating transaction search parameters such as date ranges, amounts, types, and pagination options.

methods.name: accountId
methods.description: Sets the account ID for the search request.

methods.name: fromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for transaction date filtering, parsing from string.

methods.name: toDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for transaction date filtering, parsing from string.

methods.name: fromSubmittedDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for submitted date filtering, parsing from string.

methods.name: toSubmittedDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for submitted date filtering, parsing from string.

methods.name: types
methods.description: Sets the transaction types, splitting comma-separated string.

methods.name: credit
methods.description: Filters for credit transactions if true.

methods.name: debit
methods.description: Filters for debit transactions if true.

methods.name: pageable
methods.description: Configures pagination and sorting for the search request.
